# MINSEN — OEM/ODM Sourcing & Project Coordination Partner

> MINSEN is an independent OEM/ODM sourcing and project-coordination brand based in Guangdong, China. It helps importers, distributors and private-label owners compare qualified manufacturing partners, clarify specifications, coordinate samples and inspections, and follow OEM/ODM home-appliance projects through shipment. MINSEN does not claim to own a factory or finished-goods inventory.

Last updated: 2026-10-21.

## Destination-Market Programs

- [Middle East](https://minsenair.com/markets/middle-east/): Product planning for Saudi Arabia, the UAE and wider GCC markets
- [South America](https://minsenair.com/markets/south-america/): OEM/ODM planning for Brazil and Spanish-speaking markets
- [North America](https://minsenair.com/markets/north-america/): Electrical, performance and compliance review for US and Canadian projects

## OEM/ODM Services

- Supplier comparison and product-platform shortlisting
- Specification consolidation and technical clarification
- Custom branding, housing, controls and packaging coordination
- Sample follow-up, pre-shipment inspection coordination and production photos where arranged
- Project-based MOQ, sample and production planning
- Voltage, plug, language and documentation requirements agreed by destination market
- Certification requirements reviewed per model and market; no blanket certification claim across all products
- Production is planned around approved project specifications rather than finished-goods inventory
